result.instructions: Tools for Spoke Phone, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which calls did we miss yesterday, and which team was each one assigned to?"; "Who on the sales team is available right now?"; "Show the AI summary of my last call with +44 20 7123 4567.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Spoke Phone data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run spokephone_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run spokephone_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run spokephone_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. spokephone_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: spokephone_list_calls
tools.title: List calls
tools.description: List call records (oldest first by default; pass sortOrder descending for the latest calls), with caller, direction, duration, assigned user/team and recording URLs. Filter by time window or the external party's number. Returns { meta: { next }, calls }.

since.description: Only calls created at or after this time (unix timestamp in milliseconds).

before.description: Only calls created before this time (unix timestamp in milliseconds).

modified.description: Only calls created or modified since this time (calls gain notes/recordings after they end) (unix timestamp in milliseconds).

contactNumber.description: Only calls with this external party number (+E.164).

includeActive.description: Also return calls still in progress (default false).

sortOrder.description: ascending = oldest first (the API default); descending = latest first.

next.description: Cursor from the previous reply's meta.next; omit for the first page.

tools.name: spokephone_send_sms
tools.title: Send an SMS
tools.description: WRITE: send a real SMS to a phone number (or a group MMS to several) from a company number or from a Spoke user's conversation number. The message appears in the Spoke conversation. Confirm the recipient and text with the user first. Needs an SMS-enabled number. POST /conversationMessages.

to.description: Recipient number(s) in +E.164 form. More than one sends a group MMS.

fromNumber.description: Company number to send from (+E.164). Give this OR fromUserEmail.

fromUserEmail.description: Email of the Spoke user whose conversation number sends the message. Give this OR fromNumber.

routingAction.description: Who handles replies in a new conversation.

assignUsers.description: User emails to assign (required with routingAction assign_users).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved sending this exact text to these recipients.

tools.name: spokephone_save_phonebook_contact
tools.title: Add or replace a phonebook contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact to a phonebook, REPLACING any contact there with the same contactId (other contacts are untouched). The phonebook id may be a user's email for a personal phonebook. Contacts feed caller ID. PUT /phonebooks/{id}/contacts.

phonebookId.description: Phonebook id (from spokephone_list_phonebooks) or a user's email address.

contactId.description: Your own stable id for the contact; reuse it to replace that contact.

phoneNumbers.description: At least one number, e.g. { label: 'work', value: '+442071234567' }.

countryIso.description: ISO country code for formatting local numbers, e.g. GB.

annotations.title: Add or replace a phonebook contact

tools.name: spokephone_delete_phonebook_contact
tools.title: Delete a phonebook contact
tools.description: WRITE, destructive: delete one contact from a phonebook (it stops showing in caller ID). DELETE /phonebooks/{id}/contacts/{contactId}.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved deleting this contact.
